# JARVIS UI reference images

This folder contains the original JARVIS interface reference
(`reference_ui.png`), the supplied dark command-center dashboard reference
(`reference_dashboard.png`), and original SVG artwork organized into
background, avatar, panel, and illustration subfolders. Keep reference images
as design material; do not use a screenshot as a substitute for functional UI
components.

The dashboard reference is available in Help. The SVG artwork is referenced by
`assets/themes/jarvis-ui.css` for browser-based mockups and is not loaded by the
native Tkinter UI. Use descriptive filenames when adding more design material.

Do not store API credentials, application databases, notes, or other private
user data in this folder.
